task.description: The address of the task, for example @v1/nuucognition/task.dev/<id>#ops.

steps.title: Pin
steps.next: Read the task with ops task show {{task}} --json, and its task note (a task with no note gets one: flint shard task task-new --ops {{task}}). Pin it before the first edit: flint orbh task pin {{task}}. Set doing when it is todo: ops task start {{task}}. Then run flint shard task task-sync {{task}}.

next.interactive: Do the work of {{task}}. Make each step that serves its intent a subtask in Strike. For a task.dev, record each WIP commit: ops task commit {{task}} <sha> --repo <name>. For an untyped task, name the commits in the result.
next.headless: Set the phase implementing. Do the work of {{task}}, and keep the progress current. For a task.dev, record each WIP commit: ops task commit {{task}} <sha> --repo <name>. For an untyped task, name the commits in the result. When blocked, use a deferred request.

steps.title: Built
steps.next: Write the result with ops task result {{task}} '<text>'. For a task.dev, set the stage: ops task stage {{task}} built --note '<the commits and the tests>'. Then run flint shard task task-sync {{task}}.

next.interactive: Give the person the summary of {{task}}. The review comes next in a second session: flint shard invoke task review_task --input task={{task}}. Toward the review now: skip the step close, and close the invocation with --outcome done.
next.headless: Set the phase complete. Mark this step done, and close the invocation: flint shard invocations close {{invocation}} --outcome done. Put the review_task command of the close in the result. When no parent frame is open, return with flint orbh session return --finish. When the close prints back in: (a parent frame is open), do not return: continue the parent frame.

steps.title: Close
steps.next: A task.dev closes with completed only at reviewed or verified. When the stage is right and the person confirms, close it with sk-task-close_task: ops task close {{task}}, then flint shard task task-sync {{task}}. Else skip this step with a reason, and close the invocation with --outcome done.

behaviours.say: Pin the task before the first edit: flint orbh task pin {{task}}

Before the return: write the result of {{task}}. For a task.dev, record each WIP commit with ops task commit and set built. For an untyped task, name the commits in the result. Then run flint shard task task-sync {{task}}. Put the review_task command in the result.
